title: Behind Project Batcave: A Multi-Agent Architecture Inspired by the Batman Universe

paragraphs: Everyone building a personal AI assistant defaults to Jarvis. I went with Batman. Alfred, Gordon, and Ra's run on the Claude Agent SDK, each with a cloned Dark Knight voice. Telegram is the bat signal.
This is the first post in a four-part series. Next up: Gordon.
Architecture, production deployment, memory model, and reliability design in the full post: dimeglio.dev/blog/2026-06-01-behind-project-batcave-multi-agent-architecture
Anyone else building multi-agent systems on Cloud Run? Curious how you're handling the stateless container problem.
